public_rationale: Capability failures are documented, but that does not establish why businesses did or did not replace employees. The benchmark is earlier and simulated. IBM's reported combination of replacement and hiring also shows why net employment is an inadequate causal test. The record does not connect capability gaps to the broad staffing outcome or establish precisely which executive claims were inaccurate.
limitations: This is a causal assertion, so correlation between limited capability and limited replacement is insufficient.
The named executives' allegedly exaggerated capabilities remain unspecified.
Company accounts do not establish economy-wide causation.
